name: ep_gather
description: Expert-parallel gather. For each token and hidden column, sum the rows of input_tensor selected by input_index, multiplying each by recv_topk_weight. Skip slots with negative recv_topk_ids. Accumulate in FP32 and write into the caller's [T,H] output_tensor, casting to its dtype. Return that buffer. For portable full-width results, H must be a multiple of 128. The generic implementation launches only complete hidden-column tiles and leaves any trailing columns unwritten.
